name: Suzhou Wanxiang Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Wanxiang Technology is primarily engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-precision components for the consumer electronics market. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses critical items such as BUSBARs and TCOs, which are integral to the functionality of notebook and tablet computers. The company also provides a variety of flexible functional materials, including mylar, foam trays, Nomex, pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSA), and specialized battery glues. Furthermore, it produces precision structural parts, ranging from cases for new energy power batteries and consumer electronics to general enclosures. A key offering is its selection of micro lithium-ion batteries, which includes micro prismatic, micro button, small soft pack, and micro pin battery types. Founded in 1994, Suzhou Wanxiang Technology operates from its headquarters in Suzhou, China.
